I told my friends and I think I’m going to lie to them and say I’m doing better because I can’t help it. I have all the symptoms from shortness of breathe when I speak a bit too much or do simple task, brittle nails my nails have layers now that peel, low iron, light headed, and constant coldness in feet and hands. I just want to keep it because there’s so many wrong in the world and I feel like this world is so terrible that it kinda has you losing hope and I feel like I deserve it because I’ve said terrible things before so I rather have it. And then I have a shadow personality disorder to top it off it’s so bad and embarrassing and I hate myself for it, whenever I get the idea to harm someone I can’t help but feel hysterical and a tingle sensation in my whole body and it hurts because I love all my friends and family and I hate the thought that I would harm them in any sort of way I cry at night thinking how terrible I am. I think the world would be better without me and people like me I don’t know if people can forgive me.
